name: CitadelRedeem fixed-rate live-route quotation
summary: CitadelRedeem converted a fixed USDC-denominated staking entitlement to WETH with CamelotRouter.getAmountsOut against the live WETH/USDC pool. Three linked redemptions used that mutable route quote and depleted the treasury while the pool and flash lender gained fees.
notes: CitadelRedeem's constructor fixed the treasury, bCIT, USDC.e, WETH and Camelot router, and owner transactions 13-14 seconds later bound CIT and CITStaking. Fixed-rate redemption nevertheless remained disabled because maxRedeemableFixed was zero. This owner call raised slot 0x0a from zero to 20,000 CIT, first activating the fixed path whose USDC-denominated entitlement is converted with the live USDC.e/WETH route quote. No later CIT, staking, treasury, router or fixed-cap setter executed before the campaign; the following max-variable call affects a different branch.

Across the three successful redemption receipts, treasury 0x5ed32847e33844155c18944ae84459404e432620 sends 24.842391304488882786 + 16.209329538689066771 + 10.567828449326170156 = 51.619549292504119713 WETH to the helper with no WETH return. Archive balances reconcile each component exactly: 72.668070516983737917 -> 47.825679212494855131 -> 31.616349673805788360 -> 21.048521224479618204 WETH. The linked deposit supplies exactly 2,653 CIT; the three redemptions burn 30.951666666666666666 + 20.265972222222222222 + 13.269386574074074074 CIT, and the withdrawal returns 2,411.306998087592149132 CIT. The exact 241.693001912407850868-CIT net consideration equals 205.187178472222222222 CIT retained by the token contract plus 36.505823440185628646 net burned after a 27.981202022777334316-CIT withdrawal reward mint. CIT is the verified 18-decimal Citadel token. Immediately before the first linked purchase, Camelot CIT/WETH pool 0x73d31c0b326a27a92bdacc7d46f4219c47a022ea held 30,858.676994450283426965 CIT and 25.914525972692246359 WETH, and the EOA held zero CIT. The reserve-implied price is 0.00083978084923578519117074409216673495894624855512076249886196087913167322817030897 WETH per CIT; the consideration is therefore 0.20296915440034811929674252951339791056958896839176185986689155741402339819266159 WETH, worth exactly $458.76509061647484360284823718324789532312485758684757900133898047619466623292721 at the $2,260.27 ETH observation 88 seconds before the purchase. That credit is less than one percent of the pool's WETH-side depth. The three gross WETH products are exactly $56,193.814985453764543677728197041894, $36,653.948853105031488162364539857095 and $23,891.21816681413918017700. Their $116,738.982005372935212017092736898989 sum minus the CIT credit is exact net loss $116,280.21691475646036841424449971574110467687514241315242099866101952380533376707; the shorter numeric fields are IEEE-754 renderings only. In every redemption the quote pool sends and receives the same USDC.e amount exactly (474,961.669570; 475,492.089296; 476,907.393537), gains 1.265909302277494528 + 1.271238817402037529 + 1.274439752872321937 = 3.811587872551853994 WETH, and the external Uniswap V3 lender gains 2.25 WETH per receipt. CitadelRedeem, treasury, staking, owner, EOA and helper each held zero quote-pool LP at anchor minus one; its external LPs therefore incurred no inventory loss. EOA nonces 7-11 are respectively the CIT deposit, three losses and the CIT withdrawal. Nonces 12-21 only approve, dispose, unwrap or forward already measured assets. Separate protocol-owner transactions rescued the treasury's remaining WETH; no attacker or helper transaction ever returned WETH to the treasury. The imported approximately $93,000 figure measured proceeds rather than entity-level loss.
